typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Disposition as string,
		{Move Group} as string,
		{Move Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Server Reboot Change Request} as string,
		{Cold Reboot Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Change Request} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Device CIO} as string,
		{Device AppID} as string,
		{Device Application Name} as string,
		{CI Name} as string,
		{Serial Number} as string,
		Environment as string,
		Rack as string,
		{Rack Unit Location} as string,
		DCMFlavor as string,
		{IP Address} as string,
		{CI Type} as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		{Discovered Product Name} as string,
		{TSC Name} as string,
		{Operational Status} as string,
		{Install Status} as string,
		{Hardware Status} as string,
		{Hardware Substatus} as string,
		{Operating System} as string,
		{Managed By Group} as string,
		{Supported By Group} as string,
		Category as string,
		Subcategory as string,
		{Patch Day} as string,
		{Patch Start  Time (PT)} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Middleware as string,
		{Middelware Support} as string,
		{Backed Up?} as string,
		{Backup Required} as string,
		{Avg Duration of Backup} as string,
		{Max Duration of Backup} as string,
		{Backup Comments} as string,
		{SAN Attached?} as string,
		{SAN (in GB)} as string,

		{BEAMS Device Target Platform} as string,
		{BEAMS Device Target Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Decom LPD_Follow Up Required Y/N} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Supported_By_Group as string,
		Backup_Required as string,
		DCMFlavor as string,
		Device_CIO as string,
		Device_Application_Name as string,
		BEAMS_Device_Target_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Move_Group as string,
		IP_Address as string,
		Managed_By_Group as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Operational_Status as string,
		Install_Status as string,
		WEC_SAN_Array as string,
		Patch_Start__Time__PT_ as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Status as string,
		CI_Type as string,
		Avg_Duration_of_Backup as string,
		SAN__in_GB_ as string,
		BEAMS_Device_Target_Platform as string,
		Middleware as string,
		Behind_F5_ as string,
		Rack_Unit_Location as string,
		Disposition as string,
		Patch_Day as string,
		Backed_Up_ as string,
		Environment as string,
		Hardware_Status as string,
		Server_Reboot_Change_Request as string,
		Category as string,
		Rack as string,
		Backup_Comments as string,
		Decom_LPD_Follow_Up_Required_Y_N as string,
		CI_Name as string,
		SAN_Attached_ as string,
		Move_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Serial_Number as string,
		Max_Duration_of_Backup as string,
		TSC_Name as string,
		TDM as string,
		Notes as string,
		Cold_Reboot_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Discovered_Product_Name as string,
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Operating_System as string,
		Hardware_Substatus as string,
		Subcategory as string,
		Device_AppID as string,
		Model as string,
		Change_Request as string,
		Middelware_Support as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Supported_By_Group = {Supported By Group},
		Backup_Required = {Backup Required},
		DCMFlavor,
		Device_CIO = {Device CIO},
		Device_Application_Name = {Device Application Name},
		BEAMS_Device_Target_Date = {BEAMS Device Target Date},
		Move_Group = {Move Group},
		IP_Address = {IP Address},
		Managed_By_Group = {Managed By Group},
		Manufacturer,
		Operational_Status = {Operational Status},

		WEC_SAN_Array = {WEC SAN Array},
		Patch_Start__Time__PT_ = {Patch Start  Time (PT)},
		Status,
		CI_Type = {CI Type},
		Avg_Duration_of_Backup = {Avg Duration of Backup},
		SAN__in_GB_ = {SAN (in GB)},
		BEAMS_Device_Target_Platform = {BEAMS Device Target Platform},
		Middleware,
		Behind_F5_ = {Behind F5?},
		Rack_Unit_Location = {Rack Unit Location},
		Disposition,
		Patch_Day = {Patch Day},
		Backed_Up_ = {Backed Up?},

		Rack,
		Backup_Comments = {Backup Comments},
		Decom_LPD_Follow_Up_Required_Y_N = {Decom LPD_Follow Up Required Y/N},
		CI_Name = {CI Name},
		SAN_Attached_ = {SAN Attached?},
		Move_Date = {Move Date},
		Serial_Number = {Serial Number},
		Max_Duration_of_Backup = {Max Duration of Backup},
		TSC_Name = {TSC Name},
		TDM,
		Notes,
		Cold_Reboot_Date = {Cold Reboot Date},
		Discovered_Product_Name = {Discovered Product Name},
		ImportDate,
		Operating_System = {Operating System},
		Hardware_Substatus = {Hardware Substatus},
		Subcategory,
		Device_AppID = {Device AppID},
		Model,
		Change_Request = {Change Request},
		Middelware_Support = {Middelware Support}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
